text_block_list.name: Horse Girl A
text_block_list.text:
Um, you're Gold City-senpai the model, right?
I've always wanted to talk to you at least once...!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Sorry though, I've gotta go train
right now. So maybe next time—

text_block_list.name: Horse Girl A
text_block_list.text:
Then could I just get an autograph...!
An autograph on this magazine you're in!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
No, see, I kind of make it a rule
to turn that down while on campus...

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
...Give me a break.
I don't even have much time today—

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Aah, hey there, you!
You gotta go through her agency for that stuff~!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
City's a pro, y'know! If she goes signing stuff on her own,
she'll get in suuuper big trouble☆

text_block_list.name: Horse Girl A
text_block_list.text:
Ah... I'm so sorry, I didn't know...
E-Excuse me, I'll be going!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Geez, City, are you seriously that bad at saying no?
That's hilarious~☆

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
If you entertain one person, everyone swarms you and
it gets messy, right? You should just tell 'em that~.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Shut up. Still...
"Gold City-senpai the model," huh...

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
If that's what people still call me, I'm nowhere near good enough.
I gotta work way harder.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
—Alright, time to go train.
See ya.
